This paper examines methodological frameworks for assessing contested historical narratives, particularly those questioning well-documented atrocities. We analyze how historians evaluate claims of revisionism while maintaining academic neutrality.

- **Material evidence**: Physical remains, forensic analysis, archaeological findings
